title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Practice the restarts
hook: What happens when your team gets a corner kick?
intro: Everyone stands around not sure where to go.
statement: A simple plan turns confusion into a chance.
q1: Do you practice a few set plays —
q2: or let kids figure out restarts on their own?
q3: How many chances come from restarts?
t1: Both can work. But restarts help
t2: when every player knows where to stand.
cta: Coaches — do you practice set plays?
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What happens when your team gets a corner kick?
The ball goes out. Everyone stands around not sure where to go.
A simple plan turns confusion into a chance.
Practice set plays or let kids figure it out. There is no perfect answer.
Do you practice set plays? Share your habit in the comments.
